card.name: Broken byte pieces of rare characters
card.fires_on: Responds to a stray byte piece of a rare character, often a replacement-character symbol or accented letter, that is left alone after a number, unit, or in foreign-script text. It appears just before a list item or a following word.

modes.label: Lone byte after dose or unit
modes.description: A broken symbol sits after a number or unit such as mg or AUC, where a special character was lost.

modes.label: Foreign-script or phonetic text
modes.description: A piece of a Chinese, Greek, or phonetic character inside linguistic or Buddhist text.

modes.label: Bullet before list item
modes.description: A broken bullet symbol sits at the start of an instruction list item.
